AFDatabase.Name: Cordillera Petroleo
AFDatabase.Description: Cordillera Petróleo S.A. — ISA-95 model. Fictional company for simulation and training purposes.

AFElementTemplate.Name: Extraction Run
AFElementTemplate.Description: One event frame per continuous production period of a well. Primary element = the well.

AFAttributeTemplate.Name: Total Oil Produced
AFAttributeTemplate.Description: Oil Rate of the well, Total over the event frame.

AFAttributeTemplate.Name: Total Water Produced
AFAttributeTemplate.Description: Water Rate of the well, Total over the event frame.

AFAttributeTemplate.Name: Total Gas Produced
AFAttributeTemplate.Description: Gas Rate of the well, Total over the event frame. Unit: Mscf.

AFAttributeTemplate.Name: Average Oil Rate
AFAttributeTemplate.Description: Oil Rate of the well, Average over the event frame.

AFAttributeTemplate.Name: Average Tubing Head Pressure
AFAttributeTemplate.Description: Tubing Head Pressure of the well, Average over the event frame.

AFAttributeTemplate.Name: Minimum Bottomhole Pressure
AFAttributeTemplate.Description: Bottomhole Pressure of the well, Minimum over the event frame.

AFAttributeTemplate.Name: Stop Reason
AFAttributeTemplate.Description: Sim Scenario of the well, EndTime over the event frame.

AFElementTemplate.Name: Asset Base
AFElementTemplate.Description: Root template. Every element inherits identity and the tag prefix used to build PI Point names.

AFAttributeTemplate.Name: Asset ID
AFAttributeTemplate.Description: Unique asset code. PI tags are built from it.

AFAttributeTemplate.Name: Tag Prefix
AFAttributeTemplate.Description: PI tag root, e.g. CP.BAR.W01. Used by every PI Point data reference.

AFElementTemplate.Name: Enterprise
AFElementTemplate.Description: Company level. Rolls up production and refining from all sites.

AFAttributeTemplate.Name: PI Server
AFAttributeTemplate.Description: PI Data Archive used by every PI Point data reference in the database.

AFAttributeTemplate.Name: Total Oil Production
AFAttributeTemplate.Description: Rollup: sum of Field Oil Rate of all sites

AFAttributeTemplate.Name: Total Refinery Throughput
AFAttributeTemplate.Description: Rollup: sum of Refinery Throughput of all sites

AFAnalysisTemplate.Name: Rollup Total Oil Production
AFAnalysisTemplate.Description: Sum of child elements' Field Oil Rate

AFAnalysisTemplate.Name: Rollup Total Refinery Throughput
AFAnalysisTemplate.Description: Sum of child elements' Refinery Throughput

AFElementTemplate.Name: Site
AFElementTemplate.Description: Metropolitan operating site: one oil field plus one refinery.

AFAttributeTemplate.Name: Field Oil Rate
AFAttributeTemplate.Description: Same tag as Wellfield|Total Oil Rate

AFAttributeTemplate.Name: Field Water Rate
AFAttributeTemplate.Description: Same tag as Wellfield|Total Water Rate

AFAttributeTemplate.Name: Field Gas Rate
AFAttributeTemplate.Description: Same tag as Wellfield|Total Gas Rate Unit: Mscf/d.

AFAttributeTemplate.Name: Refinery Throughput
AFAttributeTemplate.Description: Same tag as Atmospheric Distillation Unit|Throughput

AFElementTemplate.Name: Wellfield
AFElementTemplate.Description: ISA-95 work center grouping all producing wells of the site.

AFAttributeTemplate.Name: Total Oil Rate
AFAttributeTemplate.Description: Rollup: sum of child wells Oil Rate

AFAttributeTemplate.Name: Total Water Rate
AFAttributeTemplate.Description: Rollup: sum of child wells Water Rate

AFAttributeTemplate.Name: Total Gas Rate
AFAttributeTemplate.Description: Rollup: sum of child wells Gas Rate Unit: Mscf/d.

AFAnalysisTemplate.Name: Rollup Total Oil Rate
AFAnalysisTemplate.Description: Sum of child elements' Oil Rate

AFAnalysisTemplate.Name: Rollup Total Water Rate
AFAnalysisTemplate.Description: Sum of child elements' Water Rate

AFAnalysisTemplate.Name: Rollup Total Gas Rate
AFAnalysisTemplate.Description: Sum of child elements' Gas Rate

AFElementTemplate.Name: Process Unit
AFElementTemplate.Description: ISA-95 production unit (ISA-88 process cell) for continuous processing.

AFAttributeTemplate.Name: Sim Scenario
AFAttributeTemplate.Description: Active simulator scenario for this unit.

AFElementTemplate.Name: Utility System
AFElementTemplate.Description: ISA-95 work center for steam and cooling water services.

AFAttributeTemplate.Name: Sim Scenario
AFAttributeTemplate.Description: Active simulator scenario for this system.

AFAttributeTemplate.Name: Total Inventory
AFAttributeTemplate.Description: Rollup: sum of child tanks Inventory

AFElementTemplate.Name: Well
AFElementTemplate.Description: Producing oil well. Holds the extraction analysis and notification rule; lift-specific templates derive from it.

AFAttributeTemplate.Name: Sim Scenario
AFAttributeTemplate.Description: Active simulator scenario. Useful as a label for ML training.

AFAttributeTemplate.Name: Gas Rate
AFAttributeTemplate.Description: Formation gas, excludes lift gas Unit: Mscf/d.

AFAnalysisTemplate.Name: Extraction Run Detection
AFAnalysisTemplate.Description: Defined once on the Well base template, so every lift-type template and all 55 wells get it.

AFNotificationRuleTemplate.Name: Extraction Run Notification
AFNotificationRuleTemplate.Description: Sends start/stop of each Extraction Run. Add subscribers after import.

AFElementTemplate.Name: Well - Rod Pump
AFElementTemplate.Description: Beam pumping unit with sucker rods.

AFElementTemplate.Name: Equipment Base
AFElementTemplate.Description: Common nameplate data for physical equipment.

AFElementTemplate.Name: Separator
AFElementTemplate.Description: Three-phase separator (field gathering and hydrotreater HP separator).

AFElementTemplate.Name: Pipeline
AFElementTemplate.Description: Crude transfer line from the field to the refinery.

AFAttributeTemplate.Name: Outlet Salt Content
AFAttributeTemplate.Description: Pounds per thousand barrels Unit: PTB.

AFElementTemplate.Name: Vacuum Column
AFElementTemplate.Description: Vacuum fractionator fed with atmospheric residue.

AFElementTemplate.Name: Vacuum Ejector System
AFElementTemplate.Description: Steam ejectors and condensers that hold the vacuum column pressure.
